description: Tauri 2 menu-bar layer: tray icon + 320×400 popover panel with hide-on-blur, global-shortcut toggle, and macOS Accessory-policy dock hiding.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick tauri-menubar when the app lives in the macOS menu bar or Windows system tray and opens a small floating popover on click (Raycast-style launcher, quick-access panel). NOT for full desktop windows — use tauri-desktop for that.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `cargo tauri dev` — Vite serves on :1420, Tauri wraps it as a tray popover positioned under the menu-bar icon.
All Rust setup is in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`: TrayIconBuilder, tauri-plugin-positioner wiring, and the hide-on-blur WindowEvent handler.
The React surface is `src/App.tsx` — a 320×400 fixed-size panel with a search input and scrollable action list.
Add Tauri IPC commands in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` with `#[tauri::command]` and call them from the frontend with `import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core'`.
Run `cargo tauri icon path/to/icon.png` to generate the full icon set in `src-tauri/icons/` before building for distribution.
gotchas: macOS: `ActivationPolicy::Accessory` is set in the lib.rs setup closure — this hides the dock icon. Comment it out during development if you need Xcode debugger attach.
Tray icon requires at least one valid icon file. Run `cargo tauri icon <1024x1024.png>` to generate the full set before `cargo tauri build`; the icons/ directory is not scaffolded here.
Hide-on-blur on Windows fires when the user clicks the tray icon itself, causing a show-then-immediately-hide loop. Add a ~100ms debounce if you extend the focus handler.
`src-tauri/build.rs` calls `tauri_build::build()` which must stay — removing it breaks Tauri's code-generation step that produces `tauri::generate_context!()`.
architectureNotes: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` owns the TrayIconBuilder and uses tauri-plugin-positioner's `Position::TrayCenter` to place the window under the icon on left-click.
`src-tauri/src/main.rs` is a thin shim forwarding to `lib::run()` so all setup logic is testable without spawning a window.
The popover window (tauri.conf.json) is decorations:false, alwaysOnTop:true, skipTaskbar:true, resizable:false, 320×400 — changing these dims requires matching CSS changes in `src/styles.css`.

placeholders.description: {{headline}} and {{subheadline}} are substituted at compose time. Replace the SEED action list with real commands backed by #[tauri::command] handlers in lib.rs.
{{crateName}} is substituted at compose time with the snake_case project name (used for both [package].name and the lib crate name).
{{crateName}}_lib::run() is substituted at compose time to match the crate name declared in Cargo.toml.
{{projectName}} and {{packageName}} are substituted at compose time with the human-readable project name and npm package slug.
